source_title: Hyundai brings Halloween to the infotainment screen with new PEANUTS™ Display Theme - www.hyundai.news
source_excerpt:
Seasonal PEANUTS™ Halloween Display Theme now available in the Bluelink Store
Snoopy and friends feature in Halloween-themed welcome and goodbye sequences, icons and designs on select Hyundai In-Vehicle Infotainment systems
Available for IONIQ 9, IONIQ 6, IONIQ 6 N and STARIA Electric for €10
More seasonal content to follow: a PEANUTS™ Christmas Display Theme is already planned
Hyundai Motor Europe is bringing the Halloween spirit to its vehicles with a new PEANUTS™ Halloween Display Theme, now available in the Bluelink Store. The new theme gives the infotainment system in compatible Hyundai models a seasonal look, with Snoopy and his friends dressed up for the spookiest time of the year.
Once activated through an Over-the-Air download, the theme greets drivers with a dedicated Halloween welcome sequence on the infotainment screen and says goodbye to occupants with a matching animation. Halloween-themed icons and designs feature across the infotainment interface, so every trip injects an element of seasonal fun.
Hyundai’s Halloween theme is the latest addition to the company's expanding range of Display Themes. It follows the PEANUTS™ Display Themes available for selected Hyundai models since August.
All themes are part of Hyundai's Digital Features & Services, a set of on-demand functions that enable customers to personalize their vehicle. Display Themes can be purchased through the Bluelink Store and downloaded to the vehicle, with no visit to a dealer needed.
Hyundai will keep adding seasonal content, with a PEANUTS™ Christmas Display Theme already planned.
The PEANUTS™ Halloween Display Theme is live in the Bluelink Store and costs €10 as a one-off purchase. It is available for the Hyundai IONIQ 9, IONIQ 6, IONIQ 6 N and STARIA Electric models*. The theme is shown only on the infotainment (AVNT) screen. Eligible models and availability may vary by market.
* Availability and scope vary by model and market please see your local Hyundai partner or website for further details
